cohort: Women who underwent in vitro fertilization with fresh and frozen embryo transfer from January 2019 to January 2021, with all included embryo transfers resulting in live births at ≥28 weeks of gestation.
finding: There were no significant differences in pregnancy outcomes between fresh and frozen embryo transfer overall, but maternal age ≥35 years was associated with increased gestational hypertension and postpartum hemorrhage rates.
who: Women who underwent IVF and their offspring
